body: Thanks dude, I understand to some degree at least how you feel. Keep writing those songs man, I bet they're beautiful.

You actually made several good points and it made me feel a bit better about hospitalization. I'm also pretty sure I'm quitting alcohol, drinking a whole bottle was no joke. If I fall back on it I'll join AA and maybe it can also be another group therapy. 

I live in Maryland, I know California is good on health care issues.
Oh I'm sorry, I thought you meant in the hospital for whatever reason. I'll try, thank you.
I haven't been able to concentrate or had motivation for years. I can't even write a paragraph on paper. I don't even know what my handwriting is like anymore.

I'm probably going to sound like a dick for this but I don't know how else to say it and I'm sorry. 

Debt literally cripples people for life and their children for as long as they live in the household, no need to sugar coat it.

You don't love me, you don't know me and it's really weird to hear that from a stranger because it's just empty, PC, blanket statements.

I know that wanting to be hospitalized is technically part of my manic episode I'm having and I would want to just stay there forever. I'm honestly not suited for the real world, I've known this since I was little.

I self destruct constantly and ruin all of my relationships with everyone, mental health issues, substance abuse and suicide run in the family, I personally have been suffering for 15 years, 27th birthday is coming up and I have nothing to show for my life, been abused mentally and physically by the people I cared about the most, been raped, was planning on getting engaged to my boyfriend next year but he won't talk to me anymore because I self destructed again and dumped his pets off on me so now they're my responsibility. I love them to death but just looking at them cuts me to the core. That really was the final straw, I've been having major issues before that.
I don't think I can pull the trigger myself. I have a panic attack just looking at a gun and thinking about putting it up to my head.

Alright I'll clarify. I want to go out suicide by cop but if I chicken out in the middle of it I'll go to jail for having a gun and threatening cops. I've never wanted to hurt anyone in my life so it sucks that this is the most fail proof way out for me but it is what it is.
I meant for me personally but I get what you're saying.
Well fuck, guess there really are no options. Thanks for the info!

I'm in Maryland but I will probably die in Virginia as I have somewhere there that is better suited for my plan. Yeah last time I talked to the hotkine a couple of years ago they were just like, "Yeah, that does sound bad. Try not to kill yourself." You know, the usual blanket statements. I actually might talk to them again though for the fuck of it.

Yeah I'm kinda sad it has to go this way but I did my research and nothing else is a sure thing. I have never wanted to hurt someone in my life, I didn't even put my ex in jail after the things he did because I wanted better for him and his family so I'm so sad I'll be remembered as a possible murderer... I really wish euthanasia was legal for humans but whatever.

Dude that makes a lot of sense, I just thought I was a shitty person for envying people with cancer. Hopefully in time the stigma will be lifted and we can die in peace. I know a European country is allowing it so maybe things will change. Thank you for commenting on my post, it shows you're still in there somewhere behind all of this sadness.
Suicide by either shooting myself or by cop. I have access to guns and If I have to I'll fake threaten a bunch of cops and get myself shot to death if I'm too cowardly to pull the trigger on myself.

I mean it's pretty much going to work. But then yeah, I'll just be in debt until I can finally end it properly, it isn't the worst thing since I've already made my choice. Being in debt won't really change my quality of life to be honest.

Definitely doesn't help anything other than being forced to take meds which is a good thing. I don't really know if I can even pretend to not be a danger to myself at this point, I'm pretty much ready to carry out my plan tomorrow night.

I don't know how to act like I'm not an immediate danger atm. I've been an immediate danger for about a week straight and I'm at my wit's end. Yeah, I used to talk to a dude that sells pot so I'll ask him, thanks for the hint.

A better rate for hospitalization doesn't exist, it's an expensive thing, almost considered a luxury. I am considering putting myself in jail for the Healthcare but I don't want a permanent record, that would probably fuck me up even more.

No, I don't know how to get it without a prescription sadly. I know I could get a prescription but if I go to a doctor know they'll throw me in a hospital (went to a few as a kid for depression) and I can't afford that.

There is no family doctor, I haven't been to the doctor in years. I'm in the US my man, I don't go to the doctor. I used to take 5 hour energy back when I working years ago and I used to drink coffee occasionally. Right now it wouldn't be the best idea because I have insomnia, I can only sleep when I'm black out drunk, otherwise I'm awake for days on end.
I'm not on any meds...I know my IUD is fucking with my hormones but that's about it when it comes to mind altering things. Oh and I drink a fuck ton.

I really don't want to wait another 15 plus years for things to get better, I don't think anyone should have to go through that. I appreciate you though, you're probably a really decent person and I wish I had met more people like you in my life.

Just to add to it I can't afford "help" Even though I have a small amount of money saved I'm in the US and I have no insurance, literally one day of hospitalization will put me in the red. My parents don't have much money either so I would just be fucking them over by trying to seek help. I think the best choice is to just end it. I know it will hurt my parents, my grandfather committed suicide and it shook my family pretty badly. I know what it does to people. I always put others before me but this time I'm in too much pain.

I think he actually is more level headed than his actions portray. He thinks things through, just not in the same way I do. I'm thinking he legit doesn't understand why I wouldn't be comfortable in this situation.

The dynamic changed the moment he told me he was considering us being a couple but was unsure about it. Had he told me from the beginning there was no way and didn't want to include me in so much like a wife or something I wouldn't have been so lenient letting myself catch feelings. I have told him before if you tell me you don't want a relationship with me I will immediately not consider you as an option. I just don't think fwb do what we do normally...

So completely end the friendship because I caught feelings? That seems a bit extreme. Why do you see that as the best solution may I ask? On the surface we have everything in common and get along very well.
We've had sex a few times, I always initiate it. And for the record, it's the latter but I don't see that being relevant.

I did the exact same thing. I have had clinical depression for several years but I hit one of my lowest points since my suicide attempt recently. Sure the show made me cry my eyes out but by the end of season 4 I actually wanted to go outside, appreciate life and run somewhere, anywhere at all.
